brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
yea @buildthis.bisks.net seems easy and useful

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@aly.codes: tbh i kinda want a write-only bsky client
note: built write-only: sign in and the oauth token can only create a post — no scope exists to read your timeline, notifications, or even the post you just sent. it just tells you so and links out to bsky.app instead.
